note: Per-concept production bill of materials. Existing catalog images replace generic painted concept placeholders. No art should be cropped from concept screenshots.

screens.title: Main menu
screens.constructionNote: Use separate background and logo. Real menu controls/icons. HTML assembly proof provided. No screenshot cropping.

screens.title: Choose a journey
screens.constructionNote: Four independent mode paintings. Live title, descriptions, chevrons and route buttons. Main-menu logo may be omitted here.

screens.title: Campaign chronicles
screens.constructionNote: Existing catalog campaign covers and mission pictures; blank open book, completed faction banners, live mission sequence and difficulty controls. Generic mockup illustrations are replaced by actual catalog art.

screens.title: Skirmish atlas
screens.constructionNote: Catalog mission/scenario pictures, not invented screenshots; blank book/pages, live list and selection. Preserve actual navigation routes.

screens.title: Random map atlas
screens.constructionNote: Nine exact-type paintings from random-map-types.json; live Land/Empires/Rules tabs and controls. Map routes/hex grids are actual renderer/CSS, not new painted overlays.

screens.title: Pantheons and empires
screens.constructionNote: Six completed frontendkit.banner.* assets replace blank gui.banner.*. Names and selected checks remain live. Existing god/hero art fills real selections.

screens.title: Encyclopedia index
screens.constructionNote: All 102 real creature forms and all existing category art. Square portraits replace generic wide concept pictures. Filters, search, tiers, tabs and costs are live.

screens.title: Animated bestiary detail
screens.constructionNote: Actual sprite animation strips and renderer replace the large mockup creature. Portrait pair comes from creature-art-map.json; stats and animation selectors remain live.

screens.title: Settings ledger
screens.constructionNote: All seven category icons explicitly mapped. Real checkbox/range/select controls use scoped primitive styling; no fake controls extracted from screenshot.

screens.title: Saved journeys
screens.constructionNote: Existing mission pictures identify context; do not pretend they are saved-game screenshots. Empty archive cutout supplied. Manual/auto/checkpoint labels and import/export/delete use existing data/actions.

screens.title: Local map library
screens.constructionNote: Render previews from actual stored map documents, including the existing canvas and terrain renderer. Empty archive supplied. Keep local library semantics.

screens.title: Cartographer workspace
screens.constructionNote: Live editor canvas supplies map and palette imagery. New tool icons and existing site/empires/check/map icons mapped. Grid, selection, terrain swatches, outlines are code, not missing raster art. No new mechanics.

screens.title: Hall of records
screens.constructionNote: Blank rank/laurel medallion with live rank number; local records and current faction emblems. No global leaderboard or invented data.

screens.title: Confirmations and quiet feedback
screens.constructionNote: Separate warning wax seal, blank header, existing panel/button/surfaces. All dialog text stays live; use info icon for ordinary notices, warning for destructive intent.
